player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Lord Kenobi''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in March 2001.
description: This is a new and improved DSII deck which includes the New effect that helps out this deck. (See stategy section for its text)
cards: posted: Death Star II Docking Bay
posted: Death Star II Coolant Shaft
posted: Death Star II Reactor Core
posted: Oppressive Enforcement & There is No Try
posted: Come Here You Big Coward
posted: We Shall Double Our Efforts
notes: Starting (8) as posted: Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost, Endor, Endor: Bunker, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay), Operational As Planned, Death Star II, Moff Jerjerrod, Perimeter Patrol. Each of these is listed again in its type section (the section counts 11+4+14+14+11+3+1+1+1 = 60), so the starting block is not counted twice; total 60.
Operational As Planned is the starting interrupt (takes Death Star II, Jerjerrod and an Effect into hand); the strategy says to start Perimeter Patrol (or We Shall Double Our Efforts!).
Posted 'Operational as Planned' under Epic Events dested That Thing's Operational (the strategy asks 'Why only 1 That Things Operational?'; Operational As Planned is already the interrupt).
Posted 'U- 3PO' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio) (strategy: 'Arica and U3PO'); 'Commander Merrjk' dested Commander Merrejk; 'Dreadnaught' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser.
Posted 'SFS L-s9.3 TIE Cannon' dested SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons (the L-s9.3 deploys on TIE Interceptors; the deck runs ten).

Posted 'Oppressive Enforcement & There is No Try' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; Secret Plans, Come Here You Big Coward and Resistance are the 2001 Effects (no Defensive Shields yet).
We Shall Double Our Efforts! is a Tatooine card (the post calls it 'the New card' and quotes its text), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
